mutants.mechanism: Infants are charged the child price instead of nothing.
The child threshold is lowered to 2, so a 2-year-old is charged the child price.
Babies under 1 are free but ages 1 and 2 are charged the child price.
The child price constant is changed from 6 to 5, so children are charged the wrong amount.
